identity.title: Let's Play the Pokémon Card Game! Sword & Shield Arc

leadText:
----
(Japanese: Let's Play the Pokémon Card Game! Sword & Shield Arc) is a by Ryū Matsushima based on the Pokémon Trading Card Game. It was serialized in the CoroCoro Ichiban! magazine from the February 2020 issue (released on December 21, 2019) to the February 2023 issue (released on December 21, 2022). It is the sequel of Let's Play the Pokémon Card Game! Sun & Moon Arc and is followed by Let's Play the Pokémon Card Game! Scarlet & Violet Arc. It tells the story of Kenma Ibuki (Japanese: Ibuki Kenma).

Like its predecessor, this manga was collected into four volumes that are simply referred to as (Japanese: Let's Play the Pokémon Card Game!). Instead of being labeled numerically, they are individually titled (Japanese: Sword & Shield Start! Arc), (Japanese: Single Strike vs Rapid Strike Arc), (Japanese: Pokémon VSTAR Strategy! Arc), and (Japanese: VSTAR! VMAX! Fierce Duel Arc). Each volume is 192 pages long.
